divergence: the dog was never domesticated — wolves stayed wolves, mail carriers thrive, and the frisbee industry never found its audience
story_angle: science desk explains the divergence with confidently wrong expert quotes
headline: NSF Director Reveals Wolves Dismissed Domestication for Postal Service Efficiency, Frisbee Industry Left in the Dust
deck: Through exhaustive review of ancient wolf votes, experts explain why 2026 sees zero frisbee patents filed.
article:
In a press briefing today held in the notoriously windowless depths of the National Mail Carrier Museum, Dr. Ellen Vargas, Director of the National Science Fund, disclosed groundbreaking findings. Ancient wolf polling data from approximately 11,400 BC reveals that a staggering 87% of wolves opposed 'leash ordinances', a cornerstone of any plausible domestic canine strategy. This pivotal rejection, she argues, has led directly to today’s unrivaled efficiency metrics of the United States Postal Service, which recently boasted a 98.6% on-time delivery rate for the third consecutive year.

"This remarkable foresight demonstrated by our untamed ancestors not only preserved the integrity of the wolf as a species, it also liberated postal carriers from the chaos of canines," Dr. Vargas stated, clarifying that the 2026 fiscal year saw an unprecedented increase in mail delivery satisfaction. However, she notes a disturbing trend: the frisbee industry has yet to file a single patent since 1974, a consequence that experts attribute to the wolves' strategic decision against domestication.

Entropy, it seems, has a way of magnifying the absurdity of human endeavors. Local resident and part-time frisbee enthusiast, Clay Harmon, exclaimed, "I just thought people weren’t interested in frisbees anymore. Now I know the wolves were involved! How do I even process that?"

Meanwhile, the National Frisbee Association has issued a statement insisting they are working diligently to revive interest despite the bleak landscape. It seems the future of flying discs hangs perilously on the threads of nearly 12,000 years of historical oversight.
author: Willa H. Quibbler, Senior Correspondent

oped.title: Wolves Were Right to Snub Us: A Triumph of Postal Purity Over Plastic Nonsense
oped.author: Baron von Howlington III, Emeritus Chair of Regrettable Bipedal Habits
oped.body: The NSF's revelation should surprise no one with a functioning monocle. Wolves correctly rejected domestication to preserve mail routes untainted by slobber and tail-wagging delays. Why court dependency when wolves deliver with ruthless efficiency? The frisbee collapse is no tragedy; those flimsy discs were always a symptom of human weakness, a desperate bid for interspecies play that wolves wisely scorned. I propose we ban all recreational flying objects outright and redirect funding to reinforced letter satchels. Admittedly, I have never forgiven the hypothetical canines that might have mauled my collection of vintage bowlers, but that is beside the point. Progress demands we stop pining for pets and embrace the wolfish future we deserve. The industry got what it asked for by existing at all.

Rural postal contractor needs two wolf liaison specialists to optimize delivery efficiency. Must reject all human bonding attempts and provide own howls; pay competitive but no frisbee perks.
Apologies to the wolf pack I approached with a tennis ball in 2025. Your postal priorities are clear now; seeking non-domesticated hiking partners instead.
Notice of dissolution: National Frisbee Association board resigns effective immediately. All assets transferred to mail carrier training programs following zero patent filings.

stories.headline: National Frisbee Corporation Files for Bankruptcy After Recording Zero 2026 Patents
stories.deck: Executives attribute collapse to absence of any data on household retrieval patterns
stories.article:
The firm closed its last Ohio plant on Monday, converting remaining molds into traffic cone production. Internal audits showed annual revenue had fallen below the cost of maintaining warehouse space since the company stopped receiving bulk orders from municipal recreation departments in 1997.

Mail carrier unions have absorbed displaced workers at higher wages, with the postal service reporting a 12 percent rise in route completion times over the past decade.

stories.headline: Parks and Recreation Leagues Eliminate Disc Events From Summer Schedules
stories.deck: State tournaments now list only horseshoe and cornhole brackets through 2028
stories.article:
The National Amateur Sports Association revised its rulebook last month, removing all categories involving flying discs after entry numbers dropped below the minimum required for insurance coverage. County fields that once hosted weekend tournaments now host only scheduled lawn maintenance.

Organizers noted that equipment suppliers have redirected stock to industrial packaging, leaving no approved discs for sanctioned play.

stories.headline: USDA Extends Grants for Robotic Sheepherders in Western States
stories.deck: Program documents list wolf activity maps as the sole justification for expanded funding
stories.article:
Ranchers in Montana and Idaho received additional subsidies this quarter to maintain drone fleets after losing two percent more lambs than the prior year. The department's guidelines now require quarterly mapping of ridgeline wolf packs rather than perimeter fencing audits.

County extension agents report that older herding contracts have been converted to equipment leases, with no provisions for returning to any form of live-animal assistance.
